positions.title: Full Stack Engineer

The app was deployed using Heroku and Mlab. ●​ Partnered with the Sales and Marketing teams to create, sell, and market custom t-shirts for the company via social media. ●​ With a team of 4 raised $25K from private investor.

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description: ●​ Juicer Signup Promo: Promotion banner that led native users to signup for the juicer program. Led to 2x signup rate ●​ With a team of around 1000 employees raised $100M within 12 months ●​ Model Refactor: Refactored serialization/deserialization logic for core models to adhere to the Apple Codable protocol. ●​ Client Control: Client-side debugging tool to allow employees to view and add themselves to backend experiments. ●​ Version Blocker: force user upgrade to latest app version. Block user experience until upgrading. ●​ Install Branch SDK: Install Branch 3rd party SDK to provide deep linking for promotions - iOS/Android.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description: ●​ Branch webhook: Setup server webhook between Branch and Amplitude via Ruby on Rails. ●​ Bug catcher: Identified and solved consumer facing bugs on both iOS and Android. ●​ QA Scripts: Wrote test scripts for manual testing of mobile app clients (iOS and Android) ●​ Test Automation: Instantiated UI automated test framework for Android using Espresso ●​ Test Automation: Instantiated UI automated test framework for iOS using XCTest.

positions.title: Product Development Intern
positions.description: ●​ Data pipelining: Wrote script to pipeline data from iOS to Firebase database ●​ iOS UI Development: Implemented Notifications, Search and Discover, Messaging, Sharing, and Profile screens using storyboard. ●​ Influence Scores: Implemented Python script to calculate Influence Scores for various Social Media users for marketing. ●​ ARKit: QA Tester to ensure tracker functionality.

positions.title: Running Back
positions.description: Was 1 of 4 players signed during a tryout that consisted of 40+ candidates. Played as a running back and various positions on special teams.
